title: Early Refills at Tailwise Pharmacy: Travel and Lost or Damaged Medication
content:
A Tailwise Pharmacy pharmacist may dispense a refill before the refill-too-soon date only where the class allows an early-refill override, and only for one of two reasons.

## The two reasons

- **Travel**: the customer will be away past the earliest refill date. A travel override fill contains a days' supply up to the class's largest travel override fill.
- **Lost or damaged medication**: available only where the class allows lost or damaged medication to be replaced early.

## Limits on every override

- The override is refused when the overrides already used on the prescription in the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the fill date — counted as dispensed fills of that prescription recorded with an override reason — have reached the class's allowance per 365 days.
- An override still uses a fill.
- An override still requires the prescription to be active and unexpired.
- A dose increase is never an override: it needs a new authorization from the veterinarian.
- Controlled substances and short-course medications are never refilled early.

## Judgement table

| Situation presented | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Class allows overrides, reason is travel, allowance not reached, prescription active and unexpired | Override may be used, travel fill up to the class's travel maximum |
| Class allows overrides and lost or damaged replacement, reason is lost or damaged medication, allowance not reached, prescription active and unexpired | Override may be used |
| Allowance in the rolling 365 days already reached | Override refused |
| The customer's veterinarian raised the dose and the customer wants more medication sooner | Not an override; a new authorization from the veterinarian is needed |
| Rx Controlled Substance or Rx Short-Course Medication | Never refilled early |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

An Rx Maintenance Medication prescription (allowance 2 overrides per rolling 365 days) shows a travel override fill on 2025-11-20 and a lost or damaged override fill on 2026-04-02. A request for another override on 2026-09-01 falls in the 365 days ending 2026-09-01, which contain both earlier overrides; the allowance is reached and the override is refused. A request on 2026-11-21 sees only the 2026-04-02 override in its window and is within the allowance.
